chore: raise dependency cooldown to 7 days (#579)

Raises the dependency cooldown to at least 7 days for every package
manager in this repo, so a newly published (and possibly compromised)
version isn't installed until it has been public for a week.

## Changes

- pnpm: `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `minimumReleaseAge` 1440 → 10080 (24
hours → 7 days)
- Renovate: `renovate.json`: `minimumReleaseAge` 1 day → 7 days

## Notes

- Exclusions for packages published by Apify are unchanged.
- Renovate waits 7 days too. Otherwise it would open update PRs that the
package manager refuses to install.
